subject: Furious parents give US schools a big, fat F — as approval plunges dramatically
posts:
American public school approval hits a historic low in new survey data.
Evidence: 32% satisfaction, 67% dissatisfaction, Gallup poll
#Aletheia #Education

Public education systems serve communities and prepare youth effectively.
Stated Judgement: (+1.0, 0.0) — Good Preference

Institutional rot, declining test scores, and political polarization drive approval to record lows.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.7, -0.6) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
Eroding trust in educational institutions reflects systemic neglect and politicized culture wars.

Integrity: Meaningful Distortion (Hypocrisy: 6.8, z: 4)

- Gallup / Walton Foundation: PASS (0.5, 0.0) — Accurately charts declining public sentiment.
- Public School System: FAIL (-0.8, -0.7) — Plagued by plunging scores and polarization.
Just 32% of American adults are satisfied with the U.S. school system, marking the worst rating in 27 years of Gallup polling.

The Poison:
Politicization of classrooms has turned education into a partisan battleground rather than a place of learning.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing national institutional despair with the localized realities of individual schools.

Social Physics Analysis:
Political actors run a Smart Selfish Maneuver, weaponizing school dissatisfaction as a proxy war for cultural control, leaving students and parents to bear the structural strain.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. Systemic weaponization of education erodes public trust.

The Unavoidable Truth: Trust in foundational public institutions is collapsing nationwide.

The Unavoidable Lie: Blaming a single political faction fixes systemic educational decline.

Alethekanon:
When institutions fail to deliver basic competence, public faith shatters into bitter partisanship.

Awwthekanon:
Parents just want their kids to have a bright future, but they feel trapped in a broken, fighting system.

Brothekanon:
School ratings in the gutter. Nobody thinks the kids are getting ready for the real world.
